messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: [P2] Inference runtime error rate spike detected for rwd-hosted-us-east-1 (svc:redwood-runtime). Error rate > 5% over 3m. Pager duty: oncall-runtime. Auto-created war room: https://chat.redwood/nav/warrooms/WR-1767509999 :rotating_light:
Alice M: paging @Derek (oncall) now — can you acknowledge?
Derek (oncall): ack. I’m joining war room. pulling up logs.
Sanjay K: seeing increased 502/504s on the proxy, looks like kv-cache errors in the runtime. adding trace to war room.
Maria L: I'm on customer impact - starting a quick scan of active sessions and SLA customers. rough ETA to initial status update?
Derek (oncall): ETA 15m for root cause or mitigation. preliminary mitigation: failover traffic to older model variant and disable prefix caching for hot routes. doing config change now.
Alice M: good. Can we draft a short status page message in the thread for ops to copy?
Derek (oncall): draft below — will post after I confirm mitigation works: ```We are investigating increased error rates for Redwood inference requests in the us-east-1 hosted region. Some requests are returning 5xx errors. Our on-call team is actively investigating and applying mitigations to reduce customer impact. Updates every 15 minutes. No action required from customers at this time.```
Sanjay K: mitigation applied: routing rule switched to model-variant v1.9-compat for affected pool; prefix caching turned off for pool us-east-1-prod-hot. Observed error rate drop to ~2.1% over 2m.
Maria L: tracking affected tenants: pulled list of 8 high-traffic customers. raising priority customer notifications for 3 with SLA > 99.9%. Draft notification for support to send: ```Hi <Customer>, we observed increased error rates impacting inference responses in us-east-1. Our engineers applied a mitigation (traffic routed to a compatible variant) and the issue is currently being investigated. We’ll follow up with a post-incident summary.```. OK to send?
Alice M: hold until we confirm sustained decrease for 10m. post to status page now with minimal text and mark "Investigating". Use the draft status above truncated.
Derek (oncall): confirmed sustained decrease for 7m, continuing to monitor. running evictions on a couple of unhealthy workers.
incident-bot: WAR ROOM: https://chat.redwood/nav/warrooms/WR-1767509999 | Pager duty: Derek acknowledged | Incident ID: INC-2026-1767509999
Sanjay K: logs show memory churn on a subset of workers — suspect a recent kernel driver fallback on those nodes. I’m spinning replacement hosts in the dedicated pool as a fallback.
Maria L: prepping customer notification tag for the 3 high-priority customers, will queue in Intercom. waiting for final go-ahead.
Derek (oncall): labeled incident as P2 -> P1? I think still P2 given limited customer impact. keeping P2 but adding 'customer-impact' tag.
Alice M: agree. keep P2. Please confirm when support can send the three targeted messages.
Derek (oncall): support go ahead in 5m once I confirm evictions complete.
Support Bot: queued 3 messages for Intercom: draft IDs 5542, 5543, 5544. Hold until webhook:send returns 200.
Sanjay K: replacements up, traffic draining from bad hosts; error rate now 0.7% over 3m.
Maria L: sending targeted customer messages now. tagging support@customers and account reps.
Alice M: posting status page update now (ops -> status.redwood.com): ```Investigating: Increased inference error rate in us-east-1. Mitigation applied and error rates decreasing. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.```. Posted.
Derek (oncall): confirmed status page posted. I’m going to continue monitoring for 30m then hand off to next on-call.
incident-bot: NOTE: next update due in 15m. Use thread to post follow-ups.
Alice M: thanks team — please add a short internal post-incident summary template in the war room when stabilized. I'll start the RCA doc.
Derek (oncall): handoff to @Sanjay in 30m if stable. leaving notes: evicted 2 hosts, routed traffic to v1.9-compat, disabled prefix cache for hot pool.
Sanjay K: will take watch. if anything spikes, I'll page the runtime escalation policy.
Support Bot: customer messages delivered successfully for the 3 targeted accounts. Intercom webhook: 200 OK.
Maria L: closing customer impact tracker: 8 tenants affected, 3 targeted messages, no confirmed data loss, latency spikes for 12% of affected requests at peak.
Alice M: great, set reminder for a 1-hour post-incident sync and RCA kickoff. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Derek (oncall): leaving war room, monitoring logs from phone.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate returned to baseline, monitoring. Incident state: Mitigated. Remediation steps: host replacements, routing to v1.9-compat, disabled prefix cache for hot pool. Next: RCA and follow-up comms.
